name: CNERGEN
recent: Cnergenz 近期因 ESOS 行使持续发行新股，同时董事与首席财务官出现股权变动（行使及部分减持）。公司公布截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日季度业绩，营收与净利同比大幅增长。新闻方面，市场关注其 AI 需求带动盈利、新厂计划及 2Q 业绩后的股价表现。
notable: 首席财务官 Goh Mu Xuan 于 2026 年 11 月 3 日在封闭期内行使 100,000 份 ESOS 期权。
公司因 ESOS 行使发行 253,716 股新股，于 2026 年 11 月 4 日上市。
公司因 ESOS 行使发行 1,025,018 股新股，于 2026 年 10 月 6 日上市。
risks: 首席财务官 Goh Mu Xuan 在 2026 年 9 月及 10 月多次出售股份。
ESOS 行使持续发行新股，可能摊薄现有股东权益。
earnings: 截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日季度，营收为 MYR 88.145 million，环比增长 220.5%，同比增长 344.2%；净利为 MYR 8.512 million，同比增长 769.5%，净利率为 9.7%（上季为 -1.8%）。

recent_en: Cnergenz has been issuing new shares under its ESOS, while directors and the CFO have had changes in their shareholdings (exercises and some disposals). The company reported quarterly results for the period ended 30 June 2026, with revenue and net profit rising sharply year-on-year. In the news, attention is on AI-driven earnings, new plant plans and the share price reaction after the 2Q results.
notable_en: CFO Goh Mu Xuan exercised 100,000 ESOS options on 3 Nov 2026 during the closed period.
The company issued 253,716 new shares under ESOS, listed on 4 Nov 2026.
The company issued 1,025,018 new shares under ESOS, listed on 6 Oct 2026.
risks_en: CFO Goh Mu Xuan sold shares multiple times in September and October 2026.
Continued issuance of new shares under ESOS may dilute existing shareholders.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR 88.145 million, up 220.5% qoq and 344.2% yoy; net profit was MYR 8.512 million, up 769.5% yoy, with a net margin of 9.7% (previous quarter: -1.8%).
